build_optical_flow_model: build a RAFT model for estimating optical flow between pairs of image frames
run_optical_flow_forward: run the RAFT forward pass to estimate optical flow between two images with iterative refinement
create_flow_initialization: create initial flow coordinates as the difference between two coordinate grids at 1/8 resolution
upsample_flow_field: upsample a low-resolution flow field to full resolution using convex combination of upsample masks
freeze_batch_norm: freeze all BatchNorm2d layers in the RAFT model by setting them to eval mode
